backups.empty: No backups yet. Set up scheduled backups before you add your first contacts.
backups.keyWarning: The encryption key is not in the backup. Store the whole keyring separately, that is SECRET_KEY and every previous generation from SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS. Without the old generations the fingerprints of erased addresses stop matching and erased people come back with the next import.
